claim_boundary: A completed external disposition matching this schema may become candidate real authority evidence for CA-3 rights_basis and redistribution_status only. It is not automatically admitted into SOURCE_MANIFEST.csv and does not establish rights_status, provenance, source_kind, source_locator, legal clearance generally, or cross-source generality.
not_requested: general legal opinion outside CA-3 and the two named fields

actor_full_name.rule: Explicit attributable natural-person or institutional actor identity.

actor_role_or_professional_capacity.rule: Role/capacity establishing why this actor is qualified to answer the rights question.

authority_basis.rule: Evidence independent of OIC establishing the actor's professional, institutional, statutory, contractual, or delegated basis to issue the rights disposition for the stated scope.

authority_basis_reference.rule: Durable public or supplied evidence reference supporting the authority basis.

limitations_or_conditions.rule: Explicitly state any limitations, conditions, uncertainty, or scope restrictions; use an empty list only when none are asserted.

redistribution_status_reason.rule: Short factual/legal basis for the selected redistribution_status enum.

rights_basis_reason.rule: Short factual/legal basis for the selected rights_basis enum.

supporting_evidence_references.rule: References supporting the disposition; may include statute, regulation, licence, policy, permission, or other authoritative material.
